en: A colorized historic postcard showing a street with cobblestones and a row of multi‑storey Art Nouveau / early 20th‑century buildings. The focus is on a large, monumental corner building with simple geometric façades and small domes on the roofline. Trees line the street in front of a fenced yard. At the top in red letters is the caption in Latvian orthography of the time.
